eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Platform] ZeebeDeadPartition
eventTemplate.description:
Zeebe cluster has at least one DEAD partition for more than 5 minutes in namespace {dims}. zeebe.health values: 1 = healthy, 0 = degraded, -1 = dead. A dead partition halts all processing on it.

The source rule templates severity as `page` on Stable-channel clusters and `critical` otherwise via label_cloud_camunda_io_channel — metric events have no per-instance severity field, so this uses the rule's default (critical), same simplification datadog_alerts/ made.
